git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — forward-fix cycle landing items prior cycle 20260505-061047 explicitly deferred (BA OOSO[0]); architect prescription file (architect-rednote-mcp-archprop-2-3-closeout-20260505-124619.json) is the load-bearing reference
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Three parallel gaps: (1) practical-value gap — search_notes_light built in source/install but no production agent referenced it; (2) defense-in-depth gap — install path was writable between deploys; (3) silent-data-loss bug — mcp_client.py:150 took content[0] only and dropped blocks 1..N from any multi-block MCP response.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Activated the tool in meals + attractions + skill catalog. Layered enforcement: deploy-time sha256 round-trip (existing) + launch-time drift check (new) + install-time preinstall guard (new). Multi-block bug fixed by iterating content[] and concatenating text fields, with backward-compat preserved by construction for the single-block case.

new_symbols_introduced: loadStamp, compareFiles, emitFailReport, sha256OfFile, listFilesRecursively (deployStampCheck.js internal helpers)
diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Most of the volume is the new deployStampCheck.js (144 lines) per architect pseudocode + the deploy script's step f stamp writer (94 net new lines including JSON composition + git/version capture + atomic mv). Both are explicitly prescribed by the architect-rednote-mcp-archprop-2-3-closeout-20260505-124619.json file (tier_1_external reference). Reduction beyond the prescribed scope would shed required behavior. Internal helpers in deployStampCheck.js (loadStamp/compareFiles/emitFailReport/sha256OfFile/listFilesRecursively) were factored from the architect's 9-step pseudocode to keep enforceAtLaunch readable; the alternative of inlining everything would not save lines.
